summary: Frontend-only QA of the seven unified list views (projects, banking, employees, office/clients, office/tasks, office/fees, office/documents) plus regression on /invoices and /customers. Tested at desktop 1920x1080 and mobile 390x844 on the live preview URL (https://cashflow-pro-295.preview.emergentagent.com) with real logins (demo@timologio.gr for business pages, office@koletsas.gr for office pages). All shared and page-specific data-testids required by the review request are present exactly once per view; no console errors, no page errors, no horizontal page-level scroll; palette unchanged (globals.css SHA256 5016fde68189a2eddbece14ae5e48b37eb23a127d14514bf72a2516882b3682d verified). All filter GET forms submit into URL as expected; filter-clear renders only when filters are active (as designed by filtersActive in filter-bar.tsx). Out-of-range /projects?page=999 clamps to empty result without error. fees-charge-month-filter is rendered only in the charges view (?view=charges) which is correct since it is distinct from the fees-month-input generation target. No source files were modified; no data seeded or mutated.
verified_working: /projects — filter-bar, filter-q, filter-submit, filter-from, filter-to, chip-active/completed/archived, list-pagination, pagination-range, page-size-25 all present; out-of-range page=999 clamps to empty (pagination-range='0 έργα'); no console errors; no horizontal scroll (desktop & mobile).
/banking — filter-bar, filter-q, banking-status-filter, list-pagination, page-size-25 present; single filter-bar; no h-scroll; no errors.
/employees — filter-bar, filter-q, chip-active, chip-inactive, list-pagination, page-size-25 present; no errors.
/office/clients — shared filter-bar/list-pagination/page-size-25 present; q submits into URL (?pageSize=25&q=z); filter-clear appears once a filter is applied; no errors.
/office/tasks — filter-bar, filter-q, task-org-filter, filter-from, filter-to, chip-open, chip-done, chip-overdue, chip-all, list-pagination, page-size-25 all present; no h-scroll on mobile.

/office/fees — fees-view-clients + fees-view-charges tabs always present; fees-charge-month-filter renders only in ?view=charges (correct); fees-month-input (generation target) also present in charges view; filter-q submits as ?view=charges&pageSize=25&q=...&chargeMonth=; single filter-bar + list-pagination.
/office/documents — filter-bar, filter-q, filter-from, filter-to, chip-open, chip-complete, chip-expired, chip-closed, chip-all, list-pagination, page-size-25 all present.
Regression /invoices and /customers — exactly one filter-bar and one list-pagination each at desktop and mobile; no h-scroll; no console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: filter-clear is intentionally rendered only when filtersActive is true (filter-bar.tsx). This matches the shared component contract; no action needed but worth noting for future test authors so they don't assume it is always mounted.
fees-charge-month-filter is only mounted in the charges view (?view=charges). This is correct separation from fees-month-input (generation target) as specified in the review request.

Empty-state pages (e.g., business demo /projects has 0 projects) return pagination-range '0 έργα' when page is out-of-range; robust behavior. Consider a soft redirect to page=1 for cleaner URLs, but not required — no error surfaced.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of required testid/chip/filter/pagination presence checks passed across 9 pages, desktop + mobile

test_credentials: demo@timologio.gr / demo1234 (business); office@koletsas.gr / office1234 (office). No credential changes.
seed_data_creation: None. No fixtures created, no records modified, no invoices/charges/documents generated. QA3 seed data from iteration 52 remains untouched.

Business demo org has no projects data — deeper pagination/data-boundary QA on /projects requires either using the office context or seeding rows. If seeding is needed later, isolate to a TEST_ customer/project and clean up. filter-clear only appears when filtersActive; assert conditionally. Palette hash is stable. No source edits were made in this iteration.
